name: Long Look
note: R8.24, Module R2 SSD p.75. The War Destroyer with special sensors in its wing mounts, the same conversion the LRS makes of the LR (owner, 2026-10-20), and verified box by box against orion/dw.json rather than assumed from it: chull 4, cargo 4, two batteries, two transporters, two tractors, two impulse, one bridge, one auxiliary control, 8+8 warp, shields 18/18/18/16/18/18 including the odd 16 on the rear, all four tracks, and the same seven phasers on the same extended arcs - FX forward, RX aft. Mounts B and C, the two WING mounts that fired forward, are now SEN 1 and SEN 2; mount A survives alone on the centerline. A year later than the DW (Y175 against Y174), with both refits dated to match. Its sensors take TORP hits under G24.17, 'destroyed on the hits for the weapons they replaced' - they replaced option mounts, as the LRS's did. Point value prints EPV/BPV 100/80: like the LRS, the sensors cost economically and nothing in battle points. Carries the full SCOUT FUNCTIONS SUMMARY (G24.21-G24.29). NOT MODELLED: the Y170 plasma carronade (Module R10), the MINELAYER REFIT (R8.R1), and (R8.R3) for option mount firing arcs.
